title: Art. 2.1.1 — ICAO Annex 17, Art. 2.1.1
content: Each Contracting State shall have as its primary objective the safety of passengers, crew, ground personnel and the general public in all matters related to safeguarding against acts of unlawful interference with civil aviation.
